initiatives.name: SURJ Springfield-Eugene Oregon
initiatives.description: Springfield-Eugene, Oregon chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, which organizes white people around racial justice issues such as policing and immigrant driver licenses.

initiatives.name: ROAR Center
initiatives.description: A community-led mutual aid center providing resources, organizing space, and support for local initiatives. ROAR (Resource Organizing and Radical) Center serves as a hub for community organizing, skill-sharing, and direct support in Eugene.

initiatives.name: Neighborhood Anarchists
initiatives.description: We organize locally in Eugene / Springfield Oregon to help build a society where neighbors support each other to meet basic needs, individuals are free to follow their passions, and empowered communities collectively shape the future.

initiatives.name: White Bird Clinic
initiatives.description: Eugene clinic serving low-income and unhoused people with medical, dental, addiction and crisis care, and runs the CAHOOTS mobile crisis team in Springfield.

initiatives.name: CORE Eugene
initiatives.description: CORE empowers, and advocates for young people in Lane County.

initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs Eugene
initiatives.description: Volunteers cook and serve free, mostly vegan meals in Eugene, Fridays at 4pm at the Park Blocks (8th Ave and Oak St) and some Sundays.

initiatives.name: Black Thistle Street Aid
initiatives.description: Volunteer medical team giving free street outreach, monthly pop-up clinics, wound care and harm reduction supplies to unhoused people in Eugene-Springfield, OR.

initiatives.name: BareFoot Defenders
initiatives.description: Advocacy and mutual aid group for unhoused people in Eugene and Springfield. Hands out homemade heaters and survival supplies, and protests camp sweeps.

initiatives.name: Eugene Tenant Alliance
initiatives.description: Tenant advocacy group in Lane County. Lobbies the Eugene City Council and Oregon legislature for renter protections and endorses candidates through its PAC.

initiatives.name: Radical Alternative Development
initiatives.description: Punk nonprofit in Eugene that runs all-ages benefit shows and offers mental health and suicide-prevention resources for youth and adults.

initiatives.name: Pro-Bone-O Veterinary Care
initiatives.description: Nonprofit giving free vet exams, vaccines, food and supplies for pets of homeless people in Eugene, at clinics on the 2nd and 4th Sundays at the Eugene Mission.
